upstream_parsed_results.body: November 7, 2025 - When you INSERT new records using VALUES, SQLite adds them as complete rows. This approach excels at operations that add new records or update single records, as it can quickly locate and modify entire rows. DuckDB employs column-based storage, storing data by columns rather than rows. This design enables exceptional compression and minimal storage for big datasets. When performing analytical queries with SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, and aggregate functions like COUNT, AVG, and SUM, DuckDB can perform fast scans of only the needed columns.
